name: Volumetric Raymarching with SDF Density
definition: A rendering technique for volumes that modifies standard raymarching by marching through the object interior and using the SDF to represent volume density rather than surface distance.
summary: Volumetric Raymarching with SDF Density renders procedural volumes by interpreting signed distance fields as interior density, using constant steps and front-to-back blending without voxelization.
